title: Which club will Cape Verde goalkeeper Vozinha join after Chaves in 2026?
background: Vozinha is a Cape Verde international goalkeeper. Chaves is a Portuguese football club.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : An official club or player announcement, or reliable contemporaneous sports reporting confirming a completed move. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the first club Vozinha joins after leaving Chaves in 2026. Offers, negotiations, and proposed transfers do not count. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the club.
